summary: Russian forces are conducting widespread aerial attacks using jet-powered UAVs targeting multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Poltava. A Tu-22M3 bomber in the Black Sea has been identified as a threat for X-22 missile launches. Ukrainian forces have reportedly liberated Andriivka-Klevtse in the Donetsk region, resulting in 30 Russian prisoners of war.
key_points: A Tu-22M3 bomber in the Black Sea poses a threat of X-22 missile launches (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70334).
Russian jet-powered UAVs have struck civilian infrastructure in Brovary, damaging a large distribution center for the Eva retail chain (Source: @eRadarrua/105847).
Ukrainian forces liberated Andriivka-Klevtse in the Donetsk region, resulting in 30 Russian soldiers surrendering (Source: @UkraineNow/83498).
Jet-powered UAVs are targeting multiple regions including Kyiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Poltava, Kharkiv, Chernihiv, and Zaporizhzhia (Source: @eRadarrua/105903).
The Ukrainian Ministry of Defense has codified the 'Dovbush' drone, capable of flying over 2,000 km to targets in Siberia (Source: @UkraineNow/83492).
Jet-powered UAVs are moving through Chernihiv towards Kyiv regions such as Brovary and Rzhyshchiv (Source: @kpszsu/73316).
Russia is reportedly using A-50 early warning aircraft to intercept Ukrainian Flamingo missiles (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32533).
The blockade of Black Sea ports has deprived Ukraine of 30% of its fuel supplies (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32537).

sections.threat_assessment: The deployment of jet-powered UAVs across multiple Ukrainian regions indicates a sustained aerial campaign targeting both civilian and military infrastructure. The presence of Tu-22M3 bombers in the Black Sea increases the immediate threat of X-22 missile strikes. Additionally, the loss of 30% of fuel supplies due to maritime blockades presents a significant long-term logistical challenge for Ukraine.
sections.regional_response: Poland is preparing for possible attacks on energy infrastructure and is implementing the SAN anti-UAV system as part of the Eastern Shield program (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32545). The EU is preparing a large sanctions package against Russia expected in the fall (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32526).
sections.intelligence_notes: The introduction of the 'Dovbush' drone with a 2,000 km range suggests an expansion of Ukrainian long-range strike capabilities. Reports of Russian use of A-50 aircraft for missile interception highlight an evolving air defense dynamic. The reported presence of Ukrainian units in Africa is claimed by Russian sources as a response to Western interests (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32527).
